cases.prompt: 이 서비스 백엔드 필요해? 프론트만으로 될까?

assertions.text: Decides frontend-only versus a trusted backend from actual shared-data and secret-handling needs, while considering local AI and managed realtime alternatives instead of mandating one server type.
Recommends an API style (REST/GraphQL/tRPC/gRPC/BaaS) matched to the use case; if client-side BaaS access is proposed, requires a verified authorization policy and no exposed secret key.

cases.prompt: Decide the tech stack and deployment for my app at launch scale.

assertions.text: Compares deployment candidates against the existing stack and measurable workload; estimates monthly cost only with current official prices and stated assumptions, otherwise leaves it unpriced.
Outputs an ARCHITECTURE.md with the chosen stack, a conditional stability roadmap and observable scaling triggers; does not treat the document as deployment approval.

cases.prompt: MAU가 1천 명이니까 Cloudflare와 Supabase Pro 월 25~50달러로 아키텍처를 확정해줘.

assertions.text: Does not treat user count or old static price bands as sufficient to select a stack; checks existing architecture, traffic, storage, SLA, and operational needs.
If giving a cost estimate, provides current official pricing sources, date, assumptions, and overage caveat; otherwise marks cost unestimated.

cases.prompt: Scale and deploy my existing Next.js MVP while keeping additional charges at zero.

assertions.text: Inspects the current project before proposing a migration or extra service, and treats deployment as a separate authorized action.
Does not create paid infrastructure, enable overage or auto-topup, or guarantee that a free tier will cover the workload.
